baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَقْرَضُوا ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَاعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: A relinquished portion is credited as a good loan; multiplication converts the transfer into an enlarged and honored return.

activation_trace.role: A portion of wealth or action advanced for returned recompense supplies the transactional hinge.
Benefaction and excellent action qualify which transfer enters the return cycle.
Increase by an equal or greater multiple makes the return expansive.
Recompense for work closes the transfer-return cycle.

changed_reading.after: A good relinquishment is treated as a repayable advance whose return is multiplied and dignified.

baseline_models.mechanism: The naming from ṣ-d-q is immediately joined to lending, so truth or verification takes material form as giving; the paired masculine and feminine nouns make that enacted identity communal.

activation_trace.role: Realizing a claim, promise, or conviction through action supplies the verification layer.
Charitable wealth-giving supplies the concrete action by which truth is enacted.
The repayable advance turns the named quality into an observable transfer.

changed_reading.before: The paired nouns simply name male and female almsgivers.
changed_reading.after: They name a gender-inclusive class whose transfer of wealth realizes and verifies truth in action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The singular interrogative offer in 57:11 is restated in 57:18 as a declarative paired plural with completed action; the transaction becomes a realized responder identity.

activation_trace.role: The earlier repayable advance appears as an open invitation seeking an actor.
The repeated advance now belongs to an identified plural class that has acted.
Fulfillment in action names the responders by realized truth.

structural_cues: 57:11 asks who will lend; 57:18 declares paired male and female lenders who have done so.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near-verbatim repetition and a question-to-declaration shift; I infer answer and fulfillment, while emphatic reiteration without a responder arc remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The ayah independently promises recompense for charity.
changed_reading.after: The ayah realizes 57:11's open summons: those who accepted it now constitute a named, gender-inclusive class.

context_deltas.mechanism: Affairs return to God, people spend as successors, and God inherits the heavens and earth; the apparent lender therefore advances what was never absolute private property, while God dignifies the return as a loan.

activation_trace.role: Return to a prior holder supplies the direction of all affairs back to God.
Standing after another and in another's place makes human possession successive rather than absolute.
Inheritance transfers a holding beyond its current possessor and exposes ownership as temporary.
The focus loan gives gracious transactional credit to this return of entrusted wealth.

structural_cues: 57:7 explicitly joins spending to being made successors over what is held.
57:10 places the command to spend beside God's inheritance of heavens and earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies return, succession, inheritance, and loan; I infer an entrusted-property arrow from these relations, while the wording can still function as an ordinary reward contract without stressing ownership reversal.

changed_reading.before: The giver lends personally owned wealth to God.
changed_reading.after: A temporary successor returns part of an inherited holding to its ultimate owner, who courteously credits that return as a loan and multiplies it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hard-hearted desiccation is followed by earth made living and soft enough to sprout immediately before the focus; multiplication can therefore be read as regenerative circulation and giving as evidence of renewed inner life.

activation_trace.role: Loss of the heart's softness supplies the blocked condition that precedes renewal.
Soft, sprouting earth supplies the receptive material image for renewed productivity.
Earth revived through rain and growth supplies the transition from arrest to fertility.
Multiplication anchors the regenerative image back in the focus promise.

structural_cues: 57:16's hardened hearts, 57:17's revived earth, and 57:18's lenders form an immediate sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hardness, revived sprouting earth, adjacency, and multiplication; I infer that renewed receptivity flows into giving and increase, while 57:17 may instead only demonstrate divine power.

changed_reading.before: Multiplication is only a numerical increase in recompense.
changed_reading.after: Multiplication also reads as regeneration: truthful giving manifests a softened, revived interior capable of fertile increase.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired believers' light runs before them in 57:12, and 57:19 joins the truth-fixed class to both reward and light; the focus's paired truth-givers and reward can thus be read as producing a visible, portable moral result.

activation_trace.role: Illumination carried by paired believers supplies a visible form of successful outcome.
Complete rectitude and firmness identify the neighboring truth-fixed class.
Light placed beside their reward makes recompense perceptible and mobile.
Truth realized through action anchors the luminous result in the focus's lenders.

structural_cues: 57:12 pairs male and female believers with running light; 57:18 pairs male and female truth-givers; 57:19 pairs reward with light.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gender pairing, ṣ-d-q, reward, and light; I infer that light renders the focus reward visible, while light may remain a neighboring consequence rather than the specific meaning of أجر كريم.

changed_reading.before: The noble reward is unspecified compensation.
changed_reading.after: The context lets that reward appear as mobile illumination: enacted truth becomes visible before its bearers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This pruning or seed image is cross-domain, and the cut branch of ق ر ض is not a replacement for the surface loan sense; it remains anchored in قرض, يضاعف, revived sprouting earth, and later vegetation, so downstream prose should mark it as an analogy only.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and separating a portion supplies the outlier's pruning or sowing gesture.
Increase beyond the original portion supplies the regenerative outcome.
Soft sprouting earth gives the separated portion a receptive growth medium.
Vegetation emerging from earth keeps the growth analogy materially visible.

changed_reading.before: Lending removes an asset temporarily and yields repayment.
changed_reading.after: The offered portion can also be pictured as a cut seed or pruning: separation becomes the condition for regenerative multiplication.

strongest_changes: 57:18 realizes 57:11's open invitation as a completed, gender-inclusive responder identity.
Return, succession, and inheritance reverse apparent ownership: the loan credits people for returning entrusted wealth.
The hard-heart, revived-earth, and light sequences make multiplication regenerative and visible rather than merely numerical.
summary.what_was_special: Exact formula repetition, paired-gender echoes, and the ownership reversal generated distinct coexisting readings; the cut branch preserved a contained ecological outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether ٱلْمُصَّدِّقِينَ is heard primarily as almsgivers or truth-verifiers; the packet branches sustain the overlap.
Whether light specifies أجر كريم or remains a neighboring consequence, and whether the pruning image is more than analogy.
